caption: The drawing consists of several outlined geometric shapes arranged on a plain, light beige background. Each shape appears to represent a pattern piece, with straight and curved edges, small notches, and various markings, including dots, lines, hash marks, and numbers. Some shapes are rectangles, while others have more irregular, contoured forms. Several of the shapes have shaded or hatched areas indicating specific sections, and most are labeled with alphanumeric codes, such as "A-4 2", "B-1 2", and "A-1 2", written in small, neat handwriting alongside or inside the outlines. The objects are positioned loosely in the center and upper area of the page, with significant empty space around them. In the upper left corner of the page, "Plate 3" is handwritten in cursive. The lines are uniformly thin and grey, contributing to the technical and schematic appearance of the drawing.
title: Pattern for Man's Suit
